title: Bump zod only in its own PR gated by editor/schema-adapter.test.ts; zod 4 rewrites the _def introspection the editor relies on
body: The editor derives its form from the Zod schema via `_def`, internal API outside semver. package.json declares `zod: ^3.23.8` and what is installed is 3.25.76 — minors of internal churn arrived without anyone deciding (measured 2026-08-27). The choice made was to keep the range and confine every `_def` access to editor/schema-adapter.ts, whose tests assert the shapes it expects, instead of pinning the exact version. So: never read `_def` outside that file; treat any zod bump (lockfile refresh included) as its own PR with schema-adapter tests and `pnpm run test:editor` as the gate. Zod 4 changed introspection substantially: that migration will hurt, and the adapter is what keeps it to one file. If the range keeps causing surprise churn, pinning the exact version is the fallback.
not_derivable: The pin-vs-range decision, the measured drift and the zod 4 warning are not in code comments.

evidence.summary: The only file that reads zod's _def; header explains isolation.
